structured.notes: IMPORTANT: Labor warranty drops to 1 year on this tier vs 10 years on Platinum/Gold/Silver - a cliff, not a gradual step-down, and easy to miss since the parts warranty stays at 10yr across all tiers. ALSO IMPORTANT: coil model changes to EVD5X30M17A here vs EVD5X36M17A on the other three tiers - the '30' vs '36' likely indicates a different nominal tonnage/capacity, meaning Bronze may not be sized to the same load calc as the other tiers, not just lower-efficiency equipment at equal capacity. Worth confirming directly with the contractor whether Bronze was sized independently. Add-on items also lose their percentage discounts entirely at this tier (full price on humidifier, air purifier, UVC system, scent device) - the upsell menu itself gets less generous as the base tier gets cheaper.
